placements.title: Structured onboarding checklists establish operational readiness and team integration over ad-hoc documentation
placements.frame: How do standardized onboarding workflows and active shadowing establish operational readiness for new hires?
placements.why: Wren Duskfield articulates the transition to a mandatory, structured first-week onboarding checklist (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) that replaces the prior unstructured wiki documentation.
